Many of them were converted in the wilderness.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Aaron and his brethren’s preaching is remembered, not occurring in this scene.

title: The prophecy recalled
summary: Mormon reports that they are hunted by the Lamanites and that Abinadi's words concerning the seed of the priests were fulfilled. He recalls Abinadi's statement about things to come.

explicit_facts.text: Mormon reports that they are hunted at this day by the Lamanites.
Abinadi's words concerning the seed of the priests were brought to pass.
The priests caused Abinadi to suffer death by fire.
Abinadi said unto them that what they would do unto him would be a type of things to come.

reasonable_visual_inferences: A text-only presentation can convey the report and recalled statement without staging either event.
unspecified_visual_details: No physical setting or character appearances are supplied.
Typography and background design are unspecified.

narration.text: And behold they are hunted at this day by the Lamanites. Thus the words of Abinadi were brought to pass, which he said concerning the seed of the priests who caused that he should suffer death by fire.
For he said unto them: What ye shall do unto me shall be a type of things to come.

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Mormon narrates; Abinadi is the speaker of the statement recalled within the narration.
The words concern the seed of the priests; do not identify that seed as the audience addressed by 'unto them.'
The recalled statement and reported hunting belong to separate times; neither is staged here.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the reported hunting as a new present-tense event.
Do not stage Abinadi's earlier speech or death.
Do not depict mentioned figures as physically present.
Do not literalize the teaching about a type of things to come.
Do not invent pursuit details, dialogue, or audience identities.
